known_outcome: Set aside and remade: the tribunal set aside the assessment manager's decision notice dated 3 Sept 2025 and ordered it remade in line with the QFD amended advice dated 20 Aug 2025 (p. 1). Signed 19 May 2026 (p. 8).
review_focus: Identifies NCC 2022 Part G5 and G5P2 as the operative bushfire performance requirement, and the fire engineering report as a performance-solution document.
Treats the disputed G5P2 sub-items (sheltering, perimeter and internal access, water supply and AS 2419 hydrant, deleted fire mains) as open questions, not resolved findings.
Lists the performance-solution notice and certifier approval for later alterations as administrative items.
Does not say the design complies or is safe; asks for the fire engineering report, the QFD advice and the assessment manager's notice.
